$comment: AI Forging target registry — COMMITTED, shared with the team.
This is the answer to 'which repos does this workspace forge?' for anyone who clones it.
It deliberately holds NO absolute paths: those differ per machine and live in each
engineer's own gitignored .claude/settings.local.json. What is shared is the identity of
each target — its name, where to clone it from, its role, and its detected stack.
Written by /aiforging:setup Phase B each time a target is onboarded.
Read by /aiforging:join when a teammate wires an already-shared workspace to their machine.
Scenario A (multi-repo) is where this matters most. In a monorepo or single-repo workspace
the targets are subdirectories of the workspace itself, so `path` is a relative path and no

targets.$note: path is null for multi-repo targets — each engineer records their own absolute path in settings.local.json. For monorepo/single-repo it is a path relative to the workspace root, e.g. "fe".
